sv.title: Ministern skulle få sparken – då ”donerade” han 250 miljoner
sv.summary: USA:s handelsminister Howard Lutnick var på väg att få sparken av Donald Trump. Då donerade han 250 miljoner kronor till Trumps presidentbibliotek. Han fick behålla jobbet.

en.title: Minister was about to be fired – then "donated" 250 million
en.summary: US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick was about to be fired by Donald Trump. He then donated SEK 250 million to Trump's presidential library. He kept his job.
